title: Multi-Company Record Rule Audit — ir.rule Isolation, sudo() Bypass, Intercompany Module

company_domain_pattern.strict_in: [('company_id', 'in', company_ids)] — used by account.move, account.move.line, account.payment, stock.picking, purchase.order, sale.order
company_domain_pattern.parent_of: [('company_id', 'parent_of', company_ids)] — used by account.journal, account.fiscal.position, tax, account.group; supports company hierarchy visibility
company_domain_pattern.plus_false: company_ids + [False] — used by bank.statement, stock.lot, stock.location, purchase.bill.union; null-company records visible to all
company_domain_pattern.erp_manager_bypass: (1,'=',1) on res.company for ERP manager group — unrestricted cross-company company record visibility

allowed_company_ids_mechanism.context_key: allowed_company_ids in request context (set by web client on each RPC call, confirmed in web/controllers/json.py:243)
allowed_company_ids_mechanism.eval_injection: _eval_context() injects company_ids = env.companies.ids derived from context['allowed_company_ids']
allowed_company_ids_mechanism.cache_key: _compute_domain_keys() returns ['allowed_company_ids'] — company switch invalidates cached domains
allowed_company_ids_mechanism.sudo_bypass_of_validation: In sudo mode env.company and env.companies skip AccessError validation on company IDs, allowing access to any company

sudo_effect_on_company_rules.effect: ALL ir.rules bypassed including company isolation — total bypass, not partial
sudo_effect_on_company_rules.documented_warning: sudo() docstring explicitly warns: 'possibly mixing records that are meant to be isolated (e.g. records from different companies)'
sudo_effect_on_company_rules.cache_separation: Cached domain computed separately for su=True (empty) and su=False (real domain)

intercompany_module.mechanism: _post() uses moves.sudo()._interco_filter_moves() — intentional sudo to cross company boundaries
intercompany_module.with_company_pattern: with_company(payment.company_id) switches company context for cross-company clearing entry creation
intercompany_module.configuration: 3 fields on res.company: clearing journal, payable account, receivable account — must be configured per company
